stem: During interphase and mitosis of the cell cycle, the chromosomes within a cell go through a number of changes. Each chromosome is composed of DNA complexed with proteins.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
In interphase, individual chromosomes are too diffuse (long and thin) to be visible using a microscope. In this stage, the chromosomal material is known as chromatin.

State the term used to describe the proteins that are complexed with DNA and form part of chromatin.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
When viewed through a microscope, a chromosome is most clearly visible during the metaphase stage of mitosis.

Complete Fig. 1.1 to produce a labelled diagram of the metaphase stage of mitosis in an **animal** cell with **two** chromosomes.

{{figure:figure_1_1.png}}

Fig. 1.1

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Outline the changes that occur to the structure and behaviour of a chromosome:

- from the start of the S phase to the end of interphase
- during prophase of mitosis.
